payload.text: Molt 1.4.6 cut (carries issue 0099). BATS LANE BOOKED 9 Nov: ask 01M6ZC8RWJGJXQC96WP51GYDRB, granted by webber-vc (estate controller), bats now 1/1 full; molt-vc starts it when hv is at the keyboard and releases with --result plus an END to webber-vc. READINESS EVIDENCE IS VOID, not merely stale: the '9bfb1a6' recorded here on 6 Nov as the clean dry run is not a valid object in Molt, devbin, Molt-matts, Utilz or Gtools, and appears in no reflog, so nothing proves 1.4.6 was dry-run clean. Do not treat the 6 Nov note as a precondition met. hv runs, per decision 35: 'bin/devbin release v1.4.6 --dry-run' first, then 'bin/devbin release v1.4.6', both inside this one booking so the lane is held once. Then the CI read and END to devbin-vc (devbin-vc is not running as of 9 Nov 05:30Z, so that leg has no recipient yet). After the cut, kovacs: hv runs molt upgrade from a plain terminal with Claude Code quit; kovacs-sysadm checks only bwrap-userns-restrict of Molt's is in /etc/apparmor.d, both files under /var/lib/molt/apparmor, molt doctor passes, then on hv's go sudo systemctl reset-failed apparmor && sudo systemctl restart apparmor, and sends systemctl status apparmor (0099's owed proof).
